Defined and justified RTO and RPO targets for each service tier, with evidence that the architecture can achieve them.
Disaster recovery plan that has been tested within the last 12 months, with documented results and lessons learned.
Evidence of failure mode analysis showing how the system behaves when individual components fail (single points of failure eliminated).
Business continuity plan covering scenarios beyond technical failure (supplier failure, key person unavailability, facility loss).
Documented and tested failover procedures with clear triggers, decision criteria, and responsible individuals identified.
Evidence that resilience patterns (circuit breakers, retries, bulkheads, timeouts) are implemented and monitored.
